claim: A wall-aligned sprite with air behind it is not a fault: railings, gates, curtains, cobwebs, flags and bars stand free, and when seen from both sides must be two-sided (no cstat 64) and, for railings, blocking (cstat 1). Only hung things (posters, notices, boards) need a wall behind them.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-19: 'not all wall sprites will be on the wall and it doesn't mean it is wrong ... Two sided wall sprite can be used for balcony railing' (bloodmap/tile_looks.py:75-77); 'that balcony at station is not 2 sided sprite, so it is invisible from the other side' and 'that balcony railing is not solid' (projects/blood-city/level/l3_station.py:971-976); posters 'hanging mid air' (projects/blood-city/tests/test_library_city.py:413)
Campaign cstats copied from a sprite may carry bit 64: E1M2's gate sprites 473-477 (tile 1044) are cstat 8413.
use: Never refuse a free wall sprite; lint hung paper for a wall behind it.
